_notes: Model identifiers use the 'opencode/*' namespace served by the OpenCode Zen gateway credential (auth'd Aug 11, 2026 via 'opencode auth login' -> Add credential -> OpenCode Zen). FREE MODELS ONLY. STANDING RULE (Kanj, Aug 11 2026): every model id in every agent's 'models' array MUST contain 'free' - no exceptions, even for a model independently verified as cost 0/0 (e.g. 'big-pickle' was dropped despite passing the cost check, purely for not matching the naming rule). This is enforced in code, not just by convention - Select-LiveModel in Watch-Agent.ps1 filters out any configured model missing 'free' from its id before it's ever eligible to run. Additionally verified via 'opencode models opencode --verbose' (cost.input==0 && cost.output==0 && status=='active') AND smoke-tested with a real 'opencode run' call (not just catalog presence) on Aug 11, 2026. Each agent lists 'models' in priority order (primary first, then fallbacks) - Watch-Agent.ps1 health-checks the live catalog (https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models, unauthenticated) before firing and walks the list to the first model still present, since free models are explicitly time-limited per OpenCode Zen's own docs and rotate out without notice. KNOWN GOTCHA: the live Zen catalog endpoint can list a model (e.g. 'north-mini-code-free', 'ling-3.0-flash-free' as of Aug 11 2026) before the CLI's own models.dev-backed provider registry recognizes it - such a model returns UnknownError on actual 'opencode run' even though the live catalog says it exists. Both are deliberately excluded from the active chains below until a re-test confirms the CLI has caught up; don't re-add on catalog presence alone, re-run the real 'opencode run' smoke test first.

server._notes: This project attaches to the MACHINE-WIDE shared 'opencode serve' instance (Aug 11 2026: moved out of per-project ownership - was previously started/supervised by this project's own Start-OpenCodeServer.ps1, now that lives at ~\.claude\opencode-bridge-server\ and is shared by every project on this machine, registered once via its own Register-Server.ps1, not per-project). port/hostname here MUST match ~\.claude\opencode-bridge-server\config.json exactly or --attach silently can't reach it. Watch-Agent.ps1 still gracefully falls back to a standalone (cold-boot) 'opencode run' per task if this is unreachable - not fatal, just slower, and raises a throttled bridge_server_down alert when it happens.
